requiredBody: This version no longer works with the server. The update takes a minute; nothing you saved is lost.
requiredBodyFeed: This version has to be updated before it can be used again. The update takes a minute; nothing you saved is lost.
permissionBody: Turn on “Allow from this source” in the next screen, then come back.

failed.download: The download stopped. Check the connection and try again.
failed.install: Could not open the installer. Try again.
failed.checksum: The downloaded file did not match this release, so it was not installed. Try again later.

allowOnce: Android asks once to let {product} install updates.
installingBody: Tap Install on the next screen.
unfinishedBody: Tap Install again, or Later to keep using this version.

page.title: App update
page.upToDate: You are on the latest version
page.downloadingBody: Version {v} · {n} MB. You can leave this page; the download carries on.
page.error: The update information could not be read
page.playProtect: If Google Play Protect says “App scan recommended”, tap More details, then Install without scanning.
page.privacyFeed: {product} asks one public page for the newest version number. It sends nothing about you or this phone. The file is checked before Android installs it, and Android only accepts an update signed with the same key, so your data stays.
page.privacyServer: {product} asks its server for the newest version. The file is checked before Android installs it, and Android only accepts an update signed with the same key, so your data stays.

readyBody: It is {n} MB. Your data stays.
